purpose: Search for a reproducible improvement over the actual deployed calibration, not a changed-data control
features: V2 monthly MODIS features plus within-cell 0.05 degree occupancy/components, FRP quantiles, thermal contrast, confidence and daily concentration/neighbor counts from MODIS only. No year or reference-sensor input. No CAL FIRE input.
dev_selection: Select linear penalty on mean temporal-fold statewide monthly MAE. Evaluate each family and convex baseline blend on both temporal folds; select eligible candidate by 2021-2022 monthly MAE, with all evaluated candidates disclosed. Benchmark predictions occur only after saving selection.
eligibility: At least 5% lower 2021-2022 statewide monthly MAE than deployed-ratio control, and cell MAE plus north/south monthly MAE no more than 5% worse. Prefer baseline if no eligible improvement.
confirmation: Report known benchmark, backward audit, geographic transfer and CAL FIRE guarded refit sensitivity. Do not retune based on these audits. A completed candidate must improve known-benchmark monthly MAE too without >5% regional/cell degradation. Observed months and original baseline are preserved.
limits: All historical periods have been inspected. This is exploratory repeated model development, not a new independent test. Improvement needs prospective confirmation. Primary fits use exactly the same eligible 2013-2020 observations as deployed calibration; event-purged fits are a separately reported sensitivity.
